name: Josh Stamberg
bio: Joshua Collins Stamberg (born January 4, 1970) is an American actor. He was a regular cast member in the Lifetime comedy-drama series Drop Dead Diva from 2009 to 2012 and later had recurring roles on Parenthood, The Affair, and WandaVision. Stamberg was born in Washington, D.C., the son of journalist Susan Stamberg and Louis C. Stamberg. He attended the University of Wisconsin–Madison. Stamberg appeared in numerous television shows, including Nashville, Law & Order, CSI: Miami, Grey's Anatomy, and Parenthood. He also appeared in the Lie to Me pilot. Stamberg appears as S.W.O.R.D. Director Tyler Hayward in the WandaVision Marvel series on Disney+. His film appearances include Fracture, Must Love Dogs, and Kate & Leopold.
